Season 2: Decolora Adventure!'') is the fourth and final arc of {{aniseries|BW}} that aired on {{wp|TV Tokyo}} from April 25, 2013 to September 26, 2013 (with two special episodes on October 3, 2013 and March 27, 2014). It follows the ''[[Episode N]]'' arc and precedes ''{{aniseries|XY}}''. This arc follows {{Ash}}, {{an|Iris}}, and {{an|Cilan}} as they travel through the [[Decolore Islands]], a chain of islands between [[Unova]] and [[Kanto]]. During their island-hopping journey by ship, they encounter various Pokémon and adventures, meet {{an|Alexa}}, a journalist from the [[Kalos]] region, and eventually return to Kanto. The arc concludes with Ash in [[Pallet Town]], deciding to embark on a new journey to Kalos, while Iris and Cilan head to [[Johto]]. The opening theme is [[Summerly Slope]], performed by {{wp|Daisuke (singer)|Daisuke}}, and the ending theme is [[Let's Join Hands]] performed by {{wp|Shiritsu Ebisu Chugaku}}. {{spoilers}} ==Plot== Following the resolution of the Team Plasma crisis at the [[White Ruins]], {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} prepare to return to [[Kanto]]. [[Professor Juniper]] arranges to send Ash's Pokémon to {{an|Professor Oak}}'s Laboratory. Rather than taking a direct route, the group decides to travel through the [[Decolore Islands]], a scenic archipelago between [[Unova]] and Kanto, embarking on a leisurely journey by ship with [[Porter]] as their captain. During their island-hopping adventure, Ash and his friends encounter a diverse array of experiences. [[Ash's Oshawott]] wins the [[Scalchop King Competition]]. The group reunites with {{an|Professor Oak}}, who catches a {{TP|Professor Oak|Rotom}} during his visit to the islands. Ash battles in a [[Pokémon Sumo Tournament]] and wins a [[Focus Band]]. The journey takes a significant turn when they meet {{an|Alexa}}, a journalist from the [[Kalos]] region. She joins their travels and introduces them to Kalos, sparking Ash's interest in the region and its [[Kalos League|Pokémon League]]. Along the way, {{an|Iris}} reunites with [[Clair]], the [[Blackthorn City]] [[Gym Leader]], who catches a {{Shiny}} {{p|Druddigon}}. {{AP|Charizard}} returns temporarily and battles [[Iris's Dragonite]]. The group also encounters [[Chili]] and [[Cress]] again, visiting the [[Striaton Gym]]. Upon arriving in [[Kanto]], {{an|Iris}} and {{an|Cilan}} decide to head to [[Johto]] by train to pursue their own goals, parting ways with Ash and Alexa. Ash and Alexa continue to [[Pallet Town]], where Ash reunites with his {{Delia|mother}} and Professor Oak. After learning more about the Kalos region and that [[Viola|Alexa's sister]] is a [[Gym Leader]], Ash decides to challenge the Kalos League. He leaves all his Pokémon except {{AP|Pikachu}} at [[Professor Oak's Laboratory]] and receives [[Ash's clothing#Pokémon the Series: XY|new clothes]] from his mother. Meanwhile, the [[Team Rocket trio]] returns to the {{an|Team Rocket HQ}} to report to {{an|Giovanni}}, leaving their [[Unova]] Pokémon behind, with [[Jessie]] retrieving her {{TP|Jessie|Wobbuffet}}.
